what: A second full run through the live website after the testing fixes, covering one launch that opens and one that refunds
wallet: browser demo wallet 6s1j…KPFH, funded by the hosted faucet

openingLaunch.name: Teek Success Test (TSUC), minimum 0.1, cap 0.6
steps: Deposited 0.3 and prepared the private bid; the panel updated on its own without a reload
Saved a private bid of 0.25 once bidding opened
Closed bidding, requested randomness and completed the opening purchase from the page
The first claim failed because publishing two launches had drained the wallet's test SOL; after the fix, Get test funds topped it up and the claim went through
openingLaunch.openingPurchaseInstructions: SettleLaunch, InitializeVirtualPoolWithSplToken, Swap, TransferPoolCreator in one transaction
openingLaunch.note: Three failed transactions on this launch at 21:47:24 UTC were duplicate randomness callbacks sent by the MagicBlock VRF oracle. One callback landed and the program rejected the rest.

refundLaunch.name: Teek Refund Test (TREF), minimum 1, cap 1.2
steps: Deposited 0.2, below the minimum of 1, and saved a private bid of 0.2
Left it until the settlement deadline passed
Pressed Claim your refund once; the page expired the launch, brought the bid back from the private rollup and withdrew the deposit

issuesFoundAndFixed: Wallets ran out of test SOL midway; the faucet now gives 0.1 SOL and the claim and refund steps offer Get test funds
After the refund the panel kept the old state until a reload, because follow-up refreshes were dropped while a slow refresh was still running; they now queue
The record card said Opening pending after the settlement deadline; it now says the launch can only refund
